name: skyprep
label: SkyPrep
description: SkyPrep is a powerful Learning Management System (LMS) designed to help businesses and organizations deliver effective training and educational content to their employees and users.

enrollAUserIntoACource.label: Enroll a User Into a Course
enrollAUserIntoACource.description: Enroll a user into a course by user email or user ID

updateUser.label: Update User
updateUser.description: Update user information. Omitted parameters will not be updated.

user_email.label: User Email
user_email.description: The email address of the user to update (required)

first_name.label: First Name
first_name.description: The first name of the user

last_name.label: Last Name
last_name.description: The last name of the user

cell.label: Cell Phone
cell.description: The cell phone number of the user

work_phone.label: Work Phone
work_phone.description: The work phone number of the user

card_no.label: Card/ID Number
card_no.description: The unique user identifier (e.g. student #, badge #)

email_notifications.label: Email Notifications
email_notifications.description: Whether the user receives email notifications

sms_notifications.label: SMS Notifications
sms_notifications.description: Whether the user receives SMS notifications (requires Twilio integration)

access_start_date.label: Access Start Date
access_start_date.description: The date when the user can start accessing content (e.g., "July 31, 2015")

access_end_date.label: Access End Date
access_end_date.description: The date when the user can no longer access content (e.g., "July 30, 2017")

password_expiration_date.label: Password Expiration Date
password_expiration_date.description: The date when the user password expires (e.g., "July 19, 2022")
